subject: errorbars above hollow symbols (or white filled symbol)

messages.author: 452569198af8caee
messages.subject: errorbars above hollow symbols (or white filled symbol)
parts:
Hi helpers!

I've managed to complete most of my plot but I've come to a problem
with error bars. I would like to have the error bars under the hollow
or white filled symbols (I don't want to see them crossing in the
middle of the symbols). I've tried what I saw from another discussion
(named "Avoid drawing lines inside of shapes?"), but haven't managed
to do it. Here is an example code.

Thank you!

guillaume

Guillaume Théroux Rancourt
Ph.D. candidate --- Plant Biology
Université Laval, Québec, QC, Canada
guillaume.ther...@ulaval.ca

###

df <- data.frame(
val_x = runif(10,0,1),
val_y = rnorm(10,0,1),
er_x = rep(0.1,10),
er_y = rep(0.1,10),
fact1 = factor(rep(1:2,each=5)),
fact2 = factor(rep(1:5,2)))

p.xlim = aes(xmin = val_x - er_x, xmax = val_x + er_x)
p.ylim = aes(ymin = val_y - er_y, ymax = val_y + er_y)

p = qplot(val_x, val_y, data=df, fill=factor(fact1),
shape=factor(fact2), solid=T, size=4) +
scale_shape_manual(values=c(22,23,24,25,21)) +
scale_fill_manual(values=c("1"="white", "2"="black")) + theme_bw() +
geom_errorbar(p.ylim, size=0.5) + geom_errorbarh(p.xlim, size=0.5)
p

# I've come accross another problem. If I specify width in
geom_errorbarh, it doesn't seem to change as it does in geom_errorbar.
Compare the plot above with the one below: width changes on the
vertical bars, but not on the horizontal bars.

p = qplot(val_x, val_y, data=df, fill=factor(fact1),
shape=factor(fact2), solid=T, size=4) +
scale_shape_manual(values=c(22,23,24,25,21)) +
scale_fill_manual(values=c("1"="white", "2"="black")) + theme_bw() +
geom_errorbar(p.ylim, size=0.5, width=0.5) + geom_errorbarh(p.xlim,
size=0.5, width=0.5)
p

messages.subject: Re: errorbars above hollow symbols (or white filled symbol)
parts:
You are so close! Your points are filled but the errorbars get plotted
on top, just change the order:

p = ggplot(df, aes(val_x, val_y, fill=factor(fact1), shape=factor(fact2))) +

geom_errorbarh(p.xlim, size=0.5) +
geom_point(size = 4)

You use height to change the end bars on geom_errorbarh but due to a
bug it needs to be inside aes. So, you'll need to change:

p.xlim = aes(xmin = val_x - er_x, xmax = val_x + er_x, height = 0.5)

Charlotte
